learning_outcomes.text: Comprehending the basic principles and properties of chemical processes.
Facilitating the adaptation of students to the industrial environment.
Comprehending the basic principles and properties of processes

syllabus_topics: Importance and principles of chemical technology. Need for raw materials, fuel and power
Water use in the chemical industry and preparation of boiler feed water
Gaseous fuels. Purification of natural gas. Gasification of solid fuels

Kent, J.A., Riegel's handbook of Industrial Chemistry, 9th Edition, Chapman & Hall Book Co., 1992.
Mouljin, J.A., Makkee, M., Van Diepen, A., Chemical Process Technology, Wiley, 2001.
Shreve, R.N., Brink, J.A., Chemical Process Industries, McGraw Hill, 1977.
